name: ZX_AR_TAX_CONDITIONS_ALL
description: The AR_TAX_CONDITIONS_ALL table stores information about tax condition sets, which are user-defined expressions that indicate one or more conditions that each tax code within a tax group is dependent on. You can specify one or more actions for each tax condition set. . For example, you can use tax condition sets to control when a tax code is used within a tax group, when exceptions are applied to a tax code, and what requirements must be satisfied before Receivables can use a tax group. Tax conditions consist of one or more expressions, and one or more actions. . The primary key for this table is TAX_CONDITION_ID.

columns.description: User Defined Name of this Condition.

columns.name: TAX_CONDITION_TYPE
columns.description: Identifies on which instance of a tax group this condition can be used. Values include Tax Code Condition, Tax Group Constraints, and Tax Code Exceptions.

columns.description: Compiled expression
